newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian businessman shot in Budapest.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian businessman shot in Budapest.

text.p: A Hungarian businessman was shot in Budapest on Tuesday evening in the latest in a spate of bombings and violent incidents in the past two months, police said on Wednesday.
"Taking the past few day's crimes into account, the connection (with the recent hand grenade bombings) cannot be excluded," national police spokesman Laszlo Garamvolgyi told Hungarian Radio.
The 56-year-old owner of a truck parking lot, whose name was not released, was shot several times in the arm and shoulder, and suffered serious injuries, the police said.
Tuesday's incident followed a series of bombings and shooting attacks across the Hungarian capital.
A well-known Budapest underworld was shot dead, and a prominent racehorse owner and a national boxing champion were injured in gun attacks earlier this month.
Several night clubs have been badly damaged by blasts from hand grenades but no one has been hurt in the incidents.
